fixed_head_persistent_through_1p024d.interpretation: The dimension requirement grows with response horizon under the frozen comparator-relative criterion.

profile_research.interpretation: SCI-P fidelity is comparator/output dependent and cannot inherit the GW dimension.

same_dimension_state_choice.conclusion: At equal scalar dimension, state placement near the active interface is more useful than a global first moment in this B01 slice.

error_attribution.state_information: L3 captures the tested B01 future-response distinctions at the frozen small-radius gate.
error_attribution.internal_closure_resolution: Dominant low-dimension limitation. Gradient reconstruction/localization across a long layer adjacent to a local layer drives the critical fixed-flux error.
error_attribution.Richards_spatial_discretization: Separated under fixed head by same-partition CoRichards; this error collapses much faster with dimension than LARE exchange error.
error_attribution.high_dimension_residual: BC1 R8-R16 reaches an integrated residual plateau. Heun refinement floors are far smaller, and an R16 observation-lagged bottom-K control does not remove the plateau. The residual remains a Reference/operator/integration-semantics floor, not spatial reduction alone.

interpretation: The short-horizon L4 research frontier carries a material shared-host cost signal relative to R16.
The persistent R8 groundwater frontier is approximately cost-neutral relative to R16 in this implementation.
R12 is slower than R16 in this shared-host screen.
Therefore dimensional reduction does not automatically produce computational value; closure and implementation cost matter.

material_transfer.B14: Targeted lower-zone placement strongly outperforms uniform placement at dimensions four and eight in the preregistered transfer evidence.
material_transfer.implication: The placement principle transfers, but the exact B01 boundaries and minimum dimension are not universalized.

phase_A_decision: A practical Layer-ROM remains scientifically plausible, but not as a universal three-layer model.
The best-supported low-dimensional fixed-layer route is purpose dependent: L4 is the first serious short-horizon candidate, while persistent groundwater response moves the current frontier to R8.
No tested extra global moment improves the four-scalar tradeoff over explicit localization.
For the current fixed-head implementation, moving from L4 toward the persistent R8 frontier consumes nearly all of the shared-host speed signal relative to R16.
The next research value is therefore transfer and purpose-envelope qualification, not another unconstrained closure search.

next_phase_options.preferred: Prospectively test transfer of the L4/L6/R8 targeted ladder across additional soil/forcing regimes and only then open AG-WB/EVT physics.
next_phase_options.alternative: Investigate a new localized/front state only if explicit-layer transfer shows a persistent cost-fidelity gap that cannot be solved by fixed partitions.
next_phase_options.not_authorized: No production implementation, empirical fitted closure, moving-water-table semantics, application threshold, or portable performance claim.
